why: The round refuses to solicit the local arm unless the endpoint identifies itself as this model. Pinned after two truncation measurements were taken against an SSH tunnel to a different host on 2026-08-08; both hosts answer to this same model name, so nothing in the output looked wrong.
what_this_does_not_establish: That the server has the serving flags it had when this was pinned. A model id is what an endpoint is willing to say about itself. Two hosts serving the same weights with different --reasoning_parser or --tool_parser settings are indistinguishable to this check.
